name: Cassandra
description: This Test Connection validates the access against the database and basic metadata extraction of collections.

steps.name: CheckAccess
steps.description: Validate that we can properly reach the database and authenticate with the given credentials.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to connect to Cassandra, please validate the credentials

steps.name: GetSchemas
steps.description: List the keyspaces available to the user, keeping the ones `Schema Filter Pattern` targets.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch schemas, please validate if the user has enough privilege to fetch schemas.

steps.name: GetTables
steps.description: List the tables of the keyspaces in scope. Passes as soon as one of them can be read.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch tables, please validate if the user has enough privilege on the keyspaces in scope

steps.name: GetViews
steps.description: List the materialized views of the keyspaces in scope. Passes as soon as one of them can be read.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch views, please validate if the user has enough privilege to fetch views.
